youkaishomecoming.spell_editor.help.surv: §e§l--- Create My Custom Spell in Survival ---
§7Right-click a blank spell card, enter an ID, then press Enter or Create Spell.
§7Without a namespace, your player name is used as the namespace.
§7New spells start with 50 spell HP and a 100-tick timeout.
§7The Variables tab shows node use, experimental grants, and four performance budgets.
§7[ADV] hooks add executions; [EXP] features require permission from the spell base.
§7[OP] is operator-only; [X] nodes cannot be certified for Survival.
§7After creation, the editor switches to Viewport for editing and previewing.
